description: This file defines the SubmitTaskCommand class, which handles submitting tasks in the Superset application. It manages creating new tasks or joining existing ones, with locking and deduplication logic, and includes validation and error handling.

classes.name: SubmitTaskCommand
classes.description: A command class to submit or join tasks with locking, deduplication, and validation logic.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command with distributed locking, returning the task (new or existing).

methods.name: run_with_info
methods.description: Executes the command, returning a tuple of the task and a boolean indicating if it was newly created.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the command parameters, ensuring required fields and valid scope.
